native_mechanisms.scope: Actual Source/Ledger, native Candidate fit, original Generator receipt, actual Model owner creation, Candidate material and completion rereads.

native_mechanisms.name: source_operation_after_read_withdrawal_fences_completed_native_result
native_mechanisms.scope: Gate a real native witness read after the Source before read, withdraw the actual Source, require uncertain completion and no changed native/Generator bytes.

native_mechanisms.name: source_operation_cancelled_waiter_keeps_lane_then_fences
native_mechanisms.scope: Cancel the async waiter while a real native witness blocks; retain the lane permit, then fence the same original SourceBound stage.

native_mechanisms.name: source_operation_rejects_equal_capture_from_different_arc
native_mechanisms.scope: Identical captured bytes do not allow another Source/config Arc to replace the borrowed operation; standalone capture remains a full two-read API.

native_mechanisms.name: source_operation_abandoned_finish_preserves_real_native_effect_and_fences
native_mechanisms.scope: Drop the unfinished operation after a real native completion; retain durable bytes, fence readback, and recover the same completed native journal without Generator claim.

reads.unit: One actual read per original channel; a remote request/response exchange contains two directional frames.
excluded_from_build_minimum: any external launcher work or unknown/error path
reads.candidate_paging: Different protocol; Model agent owns Begin/Pages/Finish. Each actual candidate-material invocation independently costs 2 reads per Source channel.
reads.total_128_budget: not_claimed_closed; Root must aggregate every actual original channel and all bootstrap/downstream calls

ownership.source: Same sealed Source retained in a private Arc by the original native Training owner; no new owner, channel, journal, path, key, UID, grant, or scope.
ownership.operation: Non-Clone, non-Deserialize borrowed operation; full before/after material and signed context, same Source/config/baseline Arc identity, once-only finish.
ownership.uncertainty: Unfinished/error Drop fences the original Source; cancelled SourceBound async waiter retains the blocking permit and fences the same original stage; old non-Source cancellation behavior remains.
ownership.final_freshness: After Source after reads, physically reread native/Generator ownership, then verify exact retained E/D and original Freeze signature/producer at the real clock.
